d: An international organisation is seeking a Supply Chain Director to lead procurement, logistics and supply chain operations across a geographically diverse network.
We are conducting this search confidentially. The organisation’s identity and operating sector will be shared with suitable candidates during the recruitment process.

Applications are welcome from supply chain leaders worldwide, including candidates currently based outside the Middle East. This position is based in Kuwait and requires relocation for candidates living elsewhere.
You will connect supply chain strategy with operational delivery, ensuring that goods and services reach the right locations reliably, efficiently and with appropriate financial control.
The role requires a leader who can strengthen procurement practices, improve visibility across inventory and logistics, and build effective relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
You will balance service, cost and risk while developing the people, processes and systems needed to support operations across multiple markets.
q: You will bring senior supply chain leadership experience within a complex, international or multisite organisation.
Responsibility across several supply chain functions, including procurement and logistics.
International sourcing, supplier management and commercial negotiation.
Cross-border freight, customs processes and distribution.
Inventory management, warehousing and supply planning.
Budget management, operational reporting and performance improvement.
Leadership of teams and collaboration with stakeholders across different locations.
Strong procurement governance, documentation and financial discipline.

You may currently be a Supply Chain Director, Head of Supply Chain, Procurement and Logistics Director, or a Regional Supply Chain Manager with the breadth of responsibility to take on a director-level appointment.

We welcome transferable experience from different industries. Previous employment in Kuwait or the GCC is not essential; relevant international experience and the ability to operate across markets are valued.
This opportunity is open to candidates worldwide who are willing to relocate to Kuwait.
The organisation’s operating context, detailed remit, package and relocation arrangements will be discussed confidentially during the recruitment process.
